name: Radio Link Failure (RLF) Analysis
description: Step-by-step RLF root cause analysis following 3GPP TS 38.331 Sec 5.3.10
call_flow: UE measures N310 consecutive out-of-sync indications from physical layer
UE starts timer T310 (default 1000ms)
If N311 in-sync indications received before T310 expiry → RLF cancelled
T310 expires → UE declares Radio Link Failure
UE initiates RRC Re-establishment (TS 38.331 Sec 5.3.7)
UE searches for suitable cell within T311
If suitable cell found → RRCReestablishmentRequest sent
gNB accepts → RRCReestablishment + RRCReestablishmentComplete
If no suitable cell or T311 expires → UE moves to RRC_IDLE

analysis_steps.title: Identify RLF trigger
analysis_steps.instruction: Find the T310 expiry or N310 counter in the log. Note exact timestamp and UE ID. Check if T310 value matches network configuration (default 1000ms per TS 38.331).

analysis_steps.title: Check physical layer indicators
analysis_steps.instruction: Look for RSRP/RSRQ/SINR measurements before the RLF. RSRP < -110 dBm or SINR < -3 dB typically precedes RLF. Check HARQ failure rate — maxRetxThreshold reached indicates sustained poor channel.

analysis_steps.title: Analyse re-establishment outcome
analysis_steps.instruction: Did re-establishment succeed or fail? If RRCReestablishmentReject: check if UE context was available at target cell. If T311 expired: check if coverage gap exists. Note shortMAC-I mismatch indicates security context issue.

analysis_steps.title: Determine root cause category
analysis_steps.instruction: Classify the RLF: (a) Coverage hole — RSRP consistently below threshold; (b) Interference — SINR drop with adequate RSRP; (c) Handover miss — RLF shortly after HO preparation; (d) Timer misconfiguration — T310/N310/N311 values inappropriate for mobility; (e) UE power issue.

analysis_steps.title: Corrective actions
analysis_steps.instruction: Based on root cause: Coverage → site survey, tilt adjustment, add small cell. Interference → PCI planning, power control. HO miss → reduce A3 offset or TTT. Timer → tune T310/N310/N311 per TS 38.331 recommendations.

name: Handover Failure Analysis
description: Intra/inter-gNB handover failure analysis per TS 38.331 and TS 38.413
call_flow: UE sends MeasurementReport (A3/A5 event triggered)
Source gNB makes HO decision
Source gNB sends XnAP/NGAP:HandoverRequest to target
Target allocates resources → HandoverRequestAcknowledge
Source sends RRCReconfiguration with mobilityControlInfo to UE
UE starts T304 timer and attempts sync to target cell
UE completes RACH on target cell → T304 stops
UE sends RRCReconfigurationComplete to target gNB
Target sends XnAP/NGAP:HandoverNotify to source
Source releases UE context
FAILURE PATH: T304 expiry → UE initiates RRC re-establishment (cause=handoverFailure)

analysis_steps.title: Identify handover trigger
analysis_steps.instruction: Find MeasurementReport in log. Note A3/A5 event, serving and neighbour RSRP values, offset and TTT used. Check if measurement was triggered correctly per configured thresholds.

analysis_steps.title: Check HO preparation phase
analysis_steps.instruction: Was HandoverRequest sent to target? Did target acknowledge? Look for HandoverPreparationFailure — check cause (targetNotAllowed, noRadioResourcesAvailable). Check if target cell was in neighbour list.

analysis_steps.title: Check HO execution phase
analysis_steps.instruction: Was RRCReconfiguration sent? Did UE start T304? T304 expiry means UE could not synchronise to target. Check target cell frequency, SSB beam, or RACH configuration mismatch.

analysis_steps.title: Classify failure type
analysis_steps.instruction: Too-late HO: RLF before/during HO execution — reduce A3 offset or TTT. Too-early HO: re-establishment on source after HO — increase A3 offset. Wrong cell: re-establishment on third cell — fix neighbour list (ANR). Target load rejection: HandoverPreparationFailure noResources — load balancing.

analysis_steps.title: Corrective actions
analysis_steps.instruction: Too-late: decrease A3 offset by 2-3 dB or decrease TTT. Too-early: increase A3 offset or TTT. Wrong cell: update ANR, check neighbour PCIs. Preparation failure: verify target cell config, check X2/Xn interface, load balance. T304 expiry: check target SSB periodicity, PRACH config, frequency offset.

name: RACH Failure Analysis
description: Random Access Channel failure analysis per TS 38.321 Sec 5.1
call_flow: UE selects preamble index from PRACH configuration
UE transmits Msg1 (preamble) on PRACH
gNB detects preamble → sends Msg2 (RAR) in RA-RNTI window
UE receives RAR within ra-ResponseWindow → Msg3 (RRCSetupRequest) sent
gNB sends Msg4 (contention resolution / RRCSetup)
FAILURE: preamble not detected or RAR window missed → UE retransmits
preambleTransMax reached → RACH failure declared → RRC notified

analysis_steps.title: Identify RACH failure point
analysis_steps.instruction: Find preambleTransMax reached in log. Count total preamble attempts. Note which message was missing: if no Msg2 → coverage/PRACH config issue; if Msg2 received but no Msg4 → contention resolution failure.

analysis_steps.title: Check PRACH configuration
analysis_steps.instruction: Verify PRACH format, periodicity, and occasion. Check if UE is using correct SSB-to-PRACH mapping. For NR: verify SSB beam sweeping and RACH occasion alignment. Check ra-ResponseWindow duration — if too short, RAR may be missed in poor channels.

analysis_steps.title: Check radio conditions
analysis_steps.instruction: Was RSRP adequate for RACH? RSRP < -120 dBm suggests coverage boundary. Check if RACH failure occurred during mobility (handover) — different failure cause than idle-mode RACH. Check if preamble power ramping was applied (powerRampingStep).

analysis_steps.title: Determine root cause
analysis_steps.instruction: Classify: (a) Coverage — RSRP too low, increase power or add site; (b) PRACH config mismatch — verify ssb-PerRACH-OccasionAndCBPreamblesPerSSB; (c) Congestion — many UEs attempting RACH, check RACH load and back-off; (d) Handover RACH — T304 target cell RACH config issue.

analysis_steps.title: Corrective actions
analysis_steps.instruction: Coverage: increase PRACH transmit power or cell coverage. Config: align ssb-PerRACH-OccasionAndCBPreamblesPerSSB with SSB beam config. Congestion: tune preambleTransMax, backOffIndicator, increase RACH occasions. Handover: verify target PRACH config matches UE capability.

name: NAS Authentication Failure Analysis
description: 5GS/EPS NAS authentication failure analysis per TS 24.501 Sec 5.4.1
call_flow: AMF initiates authentication: sends Authentication Request (RAND, AUTN, ngKSI)
UE USIM verifies AUTN using shared key K
USIM checks SQN (sequence number) — if out of range → Synchronisation Failure
USIM computes RES* and verifies MAC in AUTN
If MAC mismatch → Authentication Failure (cause: MAC failure)
UE sends Authentication Failure to AMF
AMF/AUSF handles failure: may retry or reject registration
After N failures → Registration Reject (cause: illegal UE or authentication failure)

analysis_steps.title: Identify auth failure type
analysis_steps.instruction: Find Authentication Failure message in log. Check the cause: MAC failure (AUTN verification failed — key mismatch) vs. Synch failure (SQN out of range — counter desynchronisation). These have different root causes and fixes.

analysis_steps.title: Check SQN synchronisation (if synch failure)
analysis_steps.instruction: Synch failure means UE SQN counter is ahead of or behind the HSS/AUSF counter. UE sends AUTS in Authentication Failure for re-synchronisation. Check if this is a first occurrence or repeated — repeated synch failures indicate USIM clone or HSS counter reset.

analysis_steps.title: Check key derivation (if MAC failure)
analysis_steps.instruction: MAC failure means the computed MAC in AUTN does not match what USIM expected. Check: correct IMSI/subscription in HSS, correct Ki provisioned in USIM and HSS, AMF/AUSF correctly handling NAS security. Check if failure follows a network migration or HSS update.

analysis_steps.title: Check downstream impact
analysis_steps.instruction: How many times did auth fail? After 3 consecutive failures, AMF should reject with cause #3 (illegal UE) per TS 24.501. Check if UE entered barred state or if T3520 is running. Check if registration eventually succeeded on retry.

analysis_steps.title: Corrective actions
analysis_steps.instruction: MAC failure: re-provision USIM/HSS with correct Ki, verify AMF/AUSF config. Synch failure: allow AUTS re-sync to complete; if persistent — replace USIM or reset HSS SQN. General: check HSS/UDM-AUSF connectivity, verify IMSI is correctly provisioned.

name: PDU Session Establishment Failure
description: 5GS PDU session failure analysis per TS 24.501 Sec 6.4.1 and TS 23.502
call_flow: UE sends PDU Session Establishment Request (DNN, S-NSSAI, PDU type)
AMF selects SMF based on DNN/S-NSSAI
AMF sends Nsmf_PDUSession_CreateSMContext to SMF
SMF verifies subscription (UDM), selects UPF
SMF performs PCF policy association (if required)
SMF sends N1 SM container (PDU Session Establishment Accept) via AMF
AMF sends NAS with PDU Session Establishment Accept to UE
gNB establishes PDU session resource (NGAP PDUSessionResourceSetupRequest)
FAILURE PATH: SMF rejects → PDU Session Establishment Reject sent to UE

analysis_steps.title: Identify failure cause code
analysis_steps.instruction: Find PDU Session Establishment Reject in log. Extract the 5GSM cause code: #8 (operator barring), #26 (insufficient resources), #27 (unknown DNN), #28 (unknown PDU type), #29 (auth failed), #38 (network failure). Each has a distinct root cause.

analysis_steps.title: Check DNN/APN configuration (cause #27)
analysis_steps.instruction: Unknown DNN means SMF could not find the requested DNN in subscriber profile or local config. Verify: DNN is provisioned in UDM/HSS, AMF DNN selection config, SMF DNN profile, UPF N4 session for this DNN. Check DNN spelling — case sensitive.

analysis_steps.title: Check resource availability (cause #26)
analysis_steps.instruction: Insufficient resources: UPF could not allocate QoS flow or IP address. Check: IP pool exhaustion (DHCP/IPAM), UPF capacity, GBR admission control for QCI/5QI. Check if specific bearer type (GBR) was requested vs. available capacity.

analysis_steps.title: Check NGAP resource setup
analysis_steps.instruction: Even if NAS accepts, NGAP PDUSessionResourceSetup may fail at gNB. Check PDUSessionResourceSetupFailure cause. Verify: QoS parameters are supported by gNB, SDAP/PDCP configuration, DRB mapping, N3 tunnel establishment between gNB and UPF.

analysis_steps.title: Corrective actions
analysis_steps.instruction: DNN unknown: provision DNN in UDM, verify SMF DNN config. Resources: expand IP pool, increase UPF capacity, check GBR admission config. Auth failure: verify SMF-UDM authentication, check PCF policy. Network failure: check SMF-UPF N4 interface, SMF-AMF N11 interface connectivity.

name: NG Setup / NGAP Failure Analysis
description: NG interface setup and NGAP procedure failure analysis per TS 38.413
call_flow: gNB sends NGSetupRequest to AMF (PLMNs, TACs, slice support)
AMF responds NGSetupResponse or NGSetupFailure
UE attaches → AMF sends InitialContextSetupRequest to gNB
gNB sets up security, SRBs, DRBs → InitialContextSetupResponse
Data flows via PDU session resources
FAILURE: InitialContextSetupFailure / UEContextReleaseRequest
AMF sends UEContextReleaseCommand → gNB releases and responds UEContextReleaseComplete

analysis_steps.title: Identify NGAP failure procedure
analysis_steps.instruction: Determine which NGAP procedure failed: NGSetup, InitialContextSetup, HandoverPreparation, PDUSessionResourceSetup, or UEContextRelease with unexpected cause. Check procedure code and failure cause value.

analysis_steps.title: Check NG interface connectivity
analysis_steps.instruction: Verify gNB-AMF SCTP association is up. Check PLMN and TAC in NGSetupRequest match AMF config. Verify AMF capacity (max UEs). Check if AMF returned overload indication. Verify TLS certificates if used.

analysis_steps.title: Analyse InitialContextSetup failure
analysis_steps.instruction: InitialContextSetupFailure: check cause (radioNetwork/unspecified, radioNetwork/encryption-not-supported, nas/authentication-failure). Verify UE security capabilities match gNB supported algorithms. Check if NAS message in context setup was valid.

analysis_steps.title: Check UE context release causes
analysis_steps.instruction: UEContextRelease with cause radio-connection-with-ue-lost = RLF on gNB side. nas/normal-release = intentional by NAS. nas/authentication-failure = auth failed after context setup. handover-cancelled = HO was aborted. Each needs different follow-up.

analysis_steps.title: Corrective actions
analysis_steps.instruction: NGSetup failure: fix PLMN/TAC mismatch, check AMF connectivity, verify SCTP ports. InitialContext failure: align security algorithm config between gNB and core. Context release RLF: correlate with RRC RLF logs, investigate radio. Handover cancelled: check T304/preparation timers.
